body.name: moment-scaled stationary-overlap-preserving signed-depth alternatives
body.construction:
For \(C\ge1\), \(Q\ge1\), and \(v\in\{-1,+1\}\), take \(\mathcal X\) to be a singleton, \(\mathcal A=\{0,1\}\), \(H_t=(J_t,U_t)\in\{0,\ldots,Q\}\times\{-1,+1\}\), \(b(1)=L^{-1}\), and \(e(1)=1\).  A reset puts \(J_{t+1}=0\) and independently draws \(U_{t+1}\) with \(\Pr(U_{t+1}=u)=(1+u\varepsilon_C)/2\).  If \(J_t=Q\), reset with probability one.  If \(J_t<Q\), reset with probability \(1-\alpha\); otherwise put \(J_{t+1}=J_t+1\), retaining \(U_t\) when \(A_t=1\) and replacing it by an independent fair sign when \(A_t=0\).  Independently of the next-state draw conditional on \((J_t,U_t,A_t)\), draw \(Y_t\in\{-\gamma_0,+\gamma_0\}\) according to
\[
 \Pr_v(Y_t=y\mid J_t,U_t,A_t)
 =\frac12\left\{1+\frac{y}{\gamma_0}\frac{vc_0}{\gamma_0}U_t\mathbf 1\{J_t=Q\}\right\}.
\]
Initialize from \(d_b(j,u)=w_j(1+u\varepsilon_C L^{-j})/2\), where \(\varepsilon_C:=\min\{(C-1)/2,1/2\}\), \(\gamma_0:=\min\{M_1,\sqrt{M_2}\}\), and \(c_0:=\gamma_0(1-\alpha)/4\).
